description: Campaign mode: scan repos for winnable issues, rank survivors by friction, merge history, freshness, and verdict strength, and append them to a campaign file as SCOUTED. The campaign file dedupes against everything already claimed or PR'd. Budget-aware: stops with a resume cursor when the API budget is hit.

budget.description: Max GitHub API calls; a resume cursor is saved on budget hit

campaign_path.description: Path to the campaign JSON file ({ entries: [{repo, issue, status, pr}], cursor })

write.description: Append survivors to the campaign file; false prints only

name: scout_campaign
